title: Shard thousands of feet tall beside a Martian impact crater

tellings.quote: that's not a pyramid That's A Shard and it's thousands of feet tall

plain: A man named Joe McMoneagle says that on mapping negatives of Mars from NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory he saw, beside an impact crater, something that looked like a pyramid but was not: "That's a shard, and it's thousands of feet tall." He tells Michels he looked at the images himself, and offers it as a sign that Mars may once have had life that built things.
